notes.title: Tumbleweeds, roll out!
notes.notes:
While we're busy creating the entity system that drives everything from simple cacti to end of level bosses, there is something to share... and it is typical of game development when building complex systems... Tumbleweeds!

There's a lot going on here, even with simple tumbleweeds, to make them do what they do. 

[previewyoutube=UAo9ZY9lAjA;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the main hurdles to overcome with the entity system was getting the right animation state progress while a sprite is turning, which was debugged in a somewhat unsexy way with numbers and colours. There are 8 different views here in total, which are seamlessly transitioned - while the number changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43490797/b3f952a72fc8ffaaf642691ec9a68fd2d729b12f.jpg[/img]

They also explode!
This may or may not make it into the game, just a test of the entity system and how it can be changed to create different interaction outcomes

[previewyoutube=lrZu1OCHFQo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Get your name in the credits of Bad Pixels
notes.notes:
We'll be posting Patreon exclusive work-in-progress videos on a monthly basis. These videos will give you inside knowledge on how the game is created, using tools like Unity, VSCode (C#), Magica Voxel, Cinema 4D, Crocotile3D and Aseprite.

All tiers get access to this content and the Discord channel. Higher tiers get a credit in the game, and a copy of the game! These require a few months of rolling support to activate (except for the instant unlock tier).

Check out what is on offer here: [url=https://dadako.com/#Bad_Pixels]https://dadako.com/#Bad_Pixels[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43490797/9008e9c833d90eef4b55ae4dccf765563358c4ab.gif[/img]

The highest tier supporters get a custom interactive gravestone that can be seen by all players.

Stay Bad,

- Bad Pixels team.
